rows.en:
Hey, Protagonist.
You came...
rows.notes: ext_gyr_* is an older copy of ext_gry_* with the literal word 'shujinkou' (protagonist) instead of the player-name code. Translated as written; no \p added.

rows.en: Looks like you've learned to say hello, at least.
But your P.E. is as hopeless as ever.
Hey, Protagonist.

Y-Yuuto...
You've got remedial too?
Whoa, whoa, don't lump Yuuto in with you.

Yuuto couldn't stand watching what a slacker you are,
so he's joining you for this training.

Today we focus on endurance running!
Twenty 1500 m runs!
Fire yourselves up! Let the training begiiin!!!

I'm impressed,
Protagonist.

(Phew, it's not just Gary-sensei...
Yuuto's an amazing athlete too...)

K-Kagura-kun...
You've got remedial too?

Today we focus on endurance running!
Ten 1500 m runs!
Fire yourselves up! Let the training begiiin!!!

(Phew, it's not just Gary-sensei...
Kagura-kun's an amazing athlete too...)
(Haah~. Maybe I'll just go home...)
Huh? Isn't that...
rows.notes: 'ano asoko ni iru no wa...' = the one over there is...

rows.en:
...Took you long enough,
Protagonist.
...I've been waiting for you.
(Th-this is awkward...)
...Haven't you got something to report to me?

Where's this coming from all of a sudden...
Report? Not... really... anything? I think...
Sheesh... keeping secrets from me, you punk?!
rows.notes: 'mizukusee yarou' = you're being standoffish / not confiding in me.

rows.en:
Don't worry! Even if the other teachers object,
I, for one, will be rooting for you!!
See ya!!

No use hiding it, no use hiding it!!
Even if other teachers object, I, for one, will root for you!!
See ya!!
Hilda-sensei!

\p...
Wh-what are you doing in a place like this?

Look who's talking, Sensei. You were spacing out
in front of a shop.

I was NOT spacing out!
D-don't say such rude things! You fool...
(I thought she was looking at the boutique, though...)
...What? You look like you have something to say.
N-no! It's nothing at all!!
Then that's fine.
So what were you doing, Sensei?
What they call "window shopping," I suppose.

Window shopping...
But this is a bridal shop.

N-no, th-this is...
It doesn't mean anything... nothing at all, you hear?!

You were looking at wedding dresses, huh?
You're tall, Hilda-sensei, so one would look great on you!
I-it's not as if I'm thinking about marriage or anything
rows.notes: Unfinished on purpose; she catches herself in the next row.

rows.en:
Wait, don't you lie to me about it suiting me!
You'll never grow up to be a decent adult!!
I'm not lying.
Ngh...
(Oh, Sensei's getting flustered...)
Hilda-sensei, will you keep working once you're married?
rows.notes: Refit to the measured 420 px window.

rows.en: Hm... why do you ask such a thing?

It's just an honest question from a student
who looks up to you, Hilda-sensei.

I'd like to live a quiet life.
A dream that won't come true, though...

Please don't look so sad...
It'll come true, I'm sure of it.

If I'm being cheered up by a student,
I'm a failure as a teacher...

...And you, quit wandering around
and get on home.
Okay! Goodbye, Sensei.
(I wonder who Sensei will end up marrying?)

Sensei, what about you? Why were you spacing out
in front of a shop?

You were looking at wedding dresses, weren't you!
You're tall, Hilda-sensei, so one would look
absolutely gorgeous on you!
(P.E.'s next... who's teaching it again...)
(Huh... it's Gary-sensei and Hilda-sensei.)
Your classes are way too soft.

What did you say?! Don't you dare tell me you've
forgotten how many students your guts-and-grit
nonsense has sent to the hospital!!

Tch, it's that coddling kind of teaching
that makes 'em crack when it counts!

You're one to talk, when you're the one
breaking students!
Hmph!!
(Things are getting ugly... I'd better do something.)
U-um, excuse meee...
What?!

N-nothing...
I just thought fighting isn't a good idea...
We're NOT fighting!
(Maybe they actually get along...?)

What's gotten into you two...?
There's class soon, so maybe keep it down...
Hm... I suppose you're right...
Say, \p.
Yes, what is it?

For the next class,
which would you rather play, soccer or baseball?
...Excuse me?

What she means is, I'm asking if soccer's
better for the next class, right?
rows.notes: Gary's 'dakara' re-states Hilda's question as a loaded one; 'What she means is' makes the takeover explicit.

rows.en: Is that the only way you know how to put things?!
What're you talking about?

Don't play dumb!!
Why aren't you including baseball as an option?!!

N-now, now...
Please calm down.

I am calm...
Now, \p,
choose!!
Wh-why me...
Your luck ran out the moment you showed up here!
